name: gaffer_hosts
description: List the Gaffer scripts offered to OpenCode on this computer (Gaffer with OpenCode Link installed offers each open script when it starts): label, document, Gaffer version, and whether this conversation or another one is attached to each (attached_to: the one this conversation acts on), with the installed part's state. attach: attach one (its offerID) to this conversation, which asks permission; detach: release this conversation's script. With one offered script that no conversation uses, the first Gaffer tool call attaches it.
